reason: The README describes an in-process DSH plugin for discovering, inspecting, messaging, steering, observing, and optionally cancelling live sessions, making agent orchestration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于在同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程中的多个实时会话之间进行发现、检查、消息传递、方向调整和结果观察。
summaries.en: Enables live DeepSeek Harness sessions in the same process to discover, inspect, message, steer, and observe one another.

capabilities: Lists and inspects live sessions in the same DSH process
Sends follow-up work to another session
Steers another session at a step boundary
Observes completion of a claimed turn
